title: Hardship Assistance Programs — Plan Length, Effective Dates and Deferral Placement
content:
The length of a plan under the Hardship Assistance Programs, the date its benefit takes effect, how its first affected due date is chosen and where deferred installments go are fixed per program as follows.

## Plan length and deferrals

| Program | Fewest plan months | Most plan months | Most installments deferred per plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | 3 | 3 | 0 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | 6 | 6 | 0 |
| Term Extension Modification | 3 | 3 | 0 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | 1 | 3 | 3 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | 1 | 6 | 0 |

- **Fewest plan months**: fewest monthly due dates the plan may cover; 0 when the plan length is set by the benefit period.
- **Most plan months**: most monthly due dates the plan may cover; 0 when the plan length is set by the benefit period.
- **Most installments deferred per plan**: most installments one plan may move to the end of the term.

## Effective date, first due date and placement

| Program | Benefit takes effect from | First affected due date | Deferred installments go |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | first deferred due date | the loan's next due date at the decision date if at least 5 calendar days away, otherwise the following due date | added after the maturity date, one month each |
| Reduced Payment Plan | first plan due date | the loan's next due date at the decision date if at least 5 calendar days away, otherwise the following due date | not applicable |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | first plan due date | the loan's next due date at the decision date if at least 5 calendar days away, otherwise the following due date | not applicable |
| Term Extension Modification | first trial due date; modified terms on completion | the loan's next due date at the decision date if at least 5 calendar days away, otherwise the following due date | not applicable |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | first deferred due date | the loan's next due date at the decision date (including a past-due one) | added after the maturity date, one month each |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | military service start date (retroactive) | not applicable (rate cap runs from the service start date) | not applicable |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | acceptance date | the first day of the month after acceptance | not applicable |

## Applying the first-due-date rule (hypothetical dates)

- Decision on the 10th, loan's next due date on the 15th: the next due date is 5 calendar days away, so under the five-day rule it is the first affected due date.
- Decision on the 11th, next due date on the 15th: it is only 4 days away, so the following due date (the 15th of the next month) is the first affected due date.
- Under the Disaster Relief Deferral the next due date at the decision date is the first affected due date even when it is already past due.
